handoff.nextAction: Keep V177 rejected. The neutral, crouch, and sit front-lap response is now attributed to exact authored panel faces and stable rest-bound anterior-thigh triangle IDs. In sit, same-side front-lap hits are 5/266 left and 5/266 right within the 250 mm ray, with 1/266 each inside the diagnostic-only 30 mm distance; the deduplicated two-side lap union hits 21/532. Crouch produces more cross-side than same-side front-lap hits, so do not change bodice or cloth bake. Next make one controlled V178 front-lap-only articulation change (geometry or skin weights, one variable at a time), preserve the neutral Cloth output and all bodice inputs, then compare the existing crouch/sit measures and directly inspect the three pose renders. Fit, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release remain unverified.

findings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and all six current pose renders confirms the sharply faceted bell silhouette, irregular pleats and jagged underside; crouch lifts front and side panels from the bent thighs, while the sit view leaves most upper thigh exposed and flares side/rear panels. V177 now isolates 266 rest-bound anterior thigh triangle samples per side: in sit only 5/266 left and 5/266 right same-side samples hit their corresponding front lap within the 250 mm diagnostic ray; each has only 1 sample within the diagnostic-only 30 mm distance. The deduplicated two-side lap union hits 21/532 samples. This measured response confirms the visible coverage defect; it does not establish a fit tolerance.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in front and posed views. Their cause is not established by the renders; visible surface quality is unacceptable and needs a separately measured diagnosis after the skirt response is isolated.
